items.title: Zelenskyy questions Trump’s ‘strange’ reference to Putin as a ‘friend’
items.abstract: KYIV, Ukraine — Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy expressed frustration with the U.S. stance toward Russian leader Vladimir Putin, in the latest sign of deepening tension between Kyiv and Washington, as new questions emerged about Europe’s future financial commitments to Ukraine.
items.zh_title: 泽连斯基质疑特朗普称普京为“朋友”
items.zh_summary: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基对美国对待俄罗斯领导人弗拉基米尔·普京的立场表达了不满与挫折感。

items.title: Hackers reportedly breach US Air Force cloud platform as Pentagon insists systems are secure
items.abstract: Hackers reportedly breached the US Air Force's Cloud One platform late Friday, potentially exposing sensitive military data. The Pentagon did not specifically deny that the system had been accessed, but insists its networks remain secure amid an ongoing spate of cyber-related data incidents.
items.zh_title: 美空军云平台遭黑客入侵 军方称系统安全
items.zh_summary: 黑客据称黑入了美国空军的Cloud One云平台，可能泄露敏感军事数据，但五角大楼坚称系统安全。

items.title: United Fidelity Bank shut in biggest US bank failure in 2 years, First Citizens buys assets
items.zh_title: 联合联邦银行倒闭 为两年来美国最大规模
items.zh_summary: 联合联邦银行（United Fidelity Bank）关闭，成为两年多来美国倒闭规模最大的银行，其资产已被第一公民银行收购。

items.title: Taiwan holds local elections under Beijing's watchful gaze
items.abstract: Taiwan is electing local leaders across 22 cities and counties on Saturday amid accusations by Taiwanese authorities of attempts by China to interfere and sow distrust in the island-nation’s electoral system. Chinese authorities reject the allegations.
items.zh_title: 台湾举行地方选举 备受各方关注
items.zh_summary: 台湾地区在22个市县举行地方公职人员选举，当局指控北京方面试图进行干预。

items.zh_summary: 随着极右翼势力不断取得政治阵地，西班牙正面临着显著的政治格局转变。

items.title: Yemen government forces hit Houthi positions as UN warns of hunger crisis
items.abstract: About 1.8 million people face emergency levels of hunger in government-held areas, according to the UN.

items.zh_summary: 也门政府军对胡塞武装阵地发动打击，联合国同时发出警告，称政府控制区内约有180万人面临紧急饥饿危机。

items.title: Canada prosecutors seek 25-year prison term for suicide poison seller
items.abstract: Canadian prosecutors on Friday requested a 25-year prison sentence for a man who sold poison to help people take their own lives, stressing his victims were largely young and experiencing mental distress. items.title: Uganda starts mRNA Ebola vaccine trial in first for Africa
items.abstract: The trial targets the less common Bundibugyo strain behind the Ebola outbreak in neighbouring DRC.
items.zh_title: 乌干达启动非洲首个mRNA埃博拉疫苗试验
items.zh_summary: 乌干达启动了针对较少见的分迪布吉约（Bundibugyo）埃博拉病毒株的mRNA疫苗试验，为非洲首创。

items.title: Liberal-Nationals Set to Win Australia’s Victoria in Labor Rout
items.abstract: The Liberal-National coalition is set to win election in Australia’s state of Victoria, ending 12 years of Labor party rule, the national broadcaster ABC projected early Saturday evening.
items.zh_title: 澳维州自由国家联盟胜选 结束工党执政
items.zh_summary: 自由-国家联盟预计将在澳大利亚维多利亚州选举中获胜，从而结束工党长达12年的执政。

items.abstract: Several cities in Peru and Ecuador faced major flooding on Friday after downpours in the region linked to the exceptionally strong El Nino climate phenomenon. items.title: Trump’s tariffs have become America’s new normal
items.abstract: Even a Democratic administration may struggle to reverse tariffs that help finance Trump's tax cuts.

items.zh_summary: 特朗普政府时期的关税政策已成为美国的新常态，即便民主党政府也可能难以逆转这些为减税提供资金的关税。

items.title: Actor and comedian PJ Gallagher dies aged 51
items.abstract: PJ Gallagher appeared on Irish television for more than two decades with shows including Naked Camera and The Young Offenders.
